lines.zh: 根须从土里拔出，我迈出一步。
lines.en: My roots pull free of the soil, and I take one step.

lines.zh: 夜里我才走，白天我扎在林中。
lines.en: I walk only at night; by day I am rooted in the forest.

lines.zh: 云杉的影子拉长，我跟着挪。
lines.en: The spruce shadows lengthen, and I shift along with them.

lines.zh: 每一步都要很久，树冠才晃一下。
lines.en: Each step takes ages, and only then does my crown sway.

lines.zh: 我踩断枯枝，声音在林子深处荡开。
lines.en: I snap a dead branch, and the sound rolls deep into the woods.

lines.zh: 根须像手指，摸索着找落脚处。
lines.en: My roots feel about like fingers, searching for footing.

lines.zh: 我绕过幼树，怕碰折它们的枝。
lines.en: I go around the saplings, afraid of snapping their branches.

lines.zh: 月光落在树皮上，我慢慢转身。
lines.en: Moonlight falls on my bark, and I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 松针在我脚下积成厚毯。
lines.en: Pine needles pile into a thick carpet beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 我走一步，身后的土坑就合上了。
lines.en: I take a step, and the pit behind me closes over.

lines.zh: 老林太密，我只能侧身穿过。
lines.en: The old forest is too dense, so I pass through sideways.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸像风穿过树冠。
lines.en: My breathing sounds like wind moving through a canopy.

lines.zh: 我把根扎进土里，一动不动。
lines.en: I drive my roots into the soil and hold perfectly still.

lines.zh: 树冠上有松鼠，我装作没看见。
lines.en: There is a squirrel in my crown; I pretend not to notice.

lines.zh: 年轮在我体内转得很慢。
lines.en: The rings inside me turn very slowly.

lines.zh: 白天的光让我昏沉，我只想站着。
lines.en: Daylight makes me drowsy, and I only want to stand.

lines.zh: 松脂从裂口渗出来，很香。
lines.en: Resin seeps from a crack in my bark, fragrant and slow.

lines.zh: 我数着林子里的鸟叫，数到第七声。
lines.en: I count the birdsong in the woods and stop at seven.

lines.zh: 风来的时候，我整棵树都在响。
lines.en: When the wind comes, every part of me sounds.

lines.zh: 我的枝上挂着一枚旧松果。
lines.en: An old pinecone hangs from one of my branches.

lines.zh: 苔藓爬上我的膝，我不介意。
lines.en: Moss climbs my knee, and I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我听着地下的水声，很远。
lines.en: I listen to the water underground, very far away.

lines.zh: 有只啄木鸟在敲我，我忍了。
lines.en: A woodpecker is drumming on me, and I endure it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢合拢枝叶，像合上一本书。
lines.en: I fold my branches in slowly, like closing a book.

lines.zh: 林子安静得能听见年轮在长。
lines.en: The woods are so quiet I can hear my rings growing.

lines.zh: 我把根往深处送了送，站稳。
lines.en: I push my roots deeper and settle my weight.

lines.zh: 根须在土里悄悄换了个位置。
lines.en: My roots shift quietly under the soil.

lines.zh: 夜里我才敢动，白天太亮。
lines.en: I only dare move at night; day is too bright.

lines.zh: 有人用斧头敲我，我记住了。
lines.en: Someone struck me with an axe. I remember.

lines.zh: 我的枝上又少了一颗松果。
lines.en: Another pinecone is gone from my branch.

lines.zh: 你拿着斧头，我低头看你。
lines.en: You carry an axe, and I lower my head to look at you.

lines.zh: 你站在我根边，像一株小苗。
lines.en: You stand by my roots like a little seedling.

lines.zh: 我转过来，树皮摩擦着响。
lines.en: I turn toward you, and my bark grinds.

lines.zh: 你敲我三下，松果就归你了。
lines.en: Tap me three times, and the pinecones are yours.

lines.zh: 你的火把让我退了半步。
lines.en: Your torch makes me retreat half a step.

lines.zh: 我俯身，树冠遮住你头顶的天。
lines.en: I bend, and my crown blots out the sky above you.

lines.zh: 你不点火，我就慢慢看你。
lines.en: If you light no fire, I will study you at my leisure.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩在我的根须上，我没动。
lines.en: Your boot presses my root, and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我记得上次敲我的人，隔了七分钟。
lines.en: I remember the last one who tapped me, seven minutes ago.

lines.zh: 你把水桶提过来，我认得那个铁味。
lines.en: You bring a water bucket, and I know that iron smell.

lines.zh: 我低头，眼睛在树皮缝里亮了一下。
lines.en: I lower my head, and my eyes glint in a bark seam.

lines.zh: 你退后，我才把枝放下。
lines.en: You step back, and only then do I lower my branches.

lines.zh: 斧刃切进树皮，我整棵都在抖。
lines.en: The axe bites into my bark, and all of me shudders.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，根须从土里扯断。
lines.en: I step back, and roots tear loose from the ground.

lines.zh: 伤口渗出松脂，慢慢凝住。
lines.en: Resin seeps from the wound and slowly hardens.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但我记下了。
lines.en: The blow was light, but I have noted it.

lines.zh: 我的枝折了一根，落在地上。
lines.en: One of my branches breaks and falls to the ground.

lines.zh: 我低低地响了一声，像风穿过空树。
lines.en: I sound low, like wind through a hollow trunk.

lines.zh: 我护住树冠，往林子深处退。
lines.en: I shield my crown and retreat deeper into the woods.

lines.zh: 疼从年轮里一圈圈散开。
lines.en: The pain spreads ring by ring through my wood.

lines.zh: 我站定，把根重新压进土。
lines.en: I plant myself and press my roots back into the soil.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我要长很久才能补上。
lines.en: A hurt like this will take me ages to grow over.

lines.zh: 火把靠近，我的根就想往土里缩。
lines.en: The torch comes near and my roots want to pull into the earth.

lines.zh: 你把打火石拿出来，我僵住了。
lines.en: You take out flint and steel, and I freeze.

lines.zh: 一点火星，比任何食物都勾我。
lines.en: One spark draws me more than any kind of food.

lines.zh: 我盯着那簇火，挪不开眼。
lines.en: I stare at the flame and cannot look away.

lines.zh: 水桶一晃，我又清醒过来。
lines.en: The water bucket sloshes, and I come back to myself.

lines.zh: 雷云的味让我枝条发麻。
lines.en: The smell of storm clouds makes my branches tingle.

lines.zh: 你把火举高，我的树冠往后仰。
lines.en: You raise the fire, and my crown leans back.

lines.zh: 我竟然朝那点火光走了一步。
lines.en: To my own surprise, I take a step toward the flame.

lines.zh: 火是我唯一听得懂的语言。
lines.en: Fire is the one language I understand.

lines.zh: 别把火靠太近，我会生根的。
lines.en: Do not bring fire too close, or I will take root.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，像撞上一堵墙。
lines.en: You collide with my leg as if hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 我的根须绊了你一下，我低头看。
lines.en: My root trips you, and I lower my head to check.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，松针落了你一身。
lines.en: We bump, and pine needles shower over you.

lines.zh: 你从我枝下过，蹭掉一块树皮。
lines.en: You pass under my branch and scrape off a piece of bark.

lines.zh: 我转身时树冠扫到你的肩。
lines.en: As I turn, my crown brushes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你推我，我的根纹丝不动。
lines.en: You push me, and my roots do not budge.

lines.zh: 我踩到你的脚，立刻抬了起来。
lines.en: I step on your foot and lift my root at once.

lines.zh: 撞上我树干的东西，多半会弹开。
lines.en: Most things that hit my trunk bounce off.

lines.zh: 你挤过我身边，苔藓蹭了你一袖。
lines.en: You squeeze past me, and moss smears your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我的枝挂住你的披风，我慢慢松开。
lines.en: My branch snags your cloak, and I let it go slowly.

lines.zh: 另一棵老树在坡上，我们隔着雾看。
lines.en: Another old tree stands on the slope; we watch through mist.

lines.zh: 我把根须伸过去，缠住她的根。
lines.en: I reach my roots across and twine them around hers.

lines.zh: 林子里只有我们两棵会走。
lines.en: In this forest, only the two of us can walk.

lines.zh: 她的树冠比我高，我仰头看很久。
lines.en: Her crown is taller than mine, and I look up a long while.

lines.zh: 我们并排扎根，守同一片松林。
lines.en: We root side by side and keep the same pine wood.

lines.zh: 松果落在我们之间，谁也没捡。
lines.en: A pinecone falls between us, and neither of us picks it up.

lines.zh: 她的年轮比我多，我慢慢学。
lines.en: She has more rings than I do, and I learn slowly.

lines.zh: 风来时我们一起摇，节拍刚好。
lines.en: When the wind comes we sway together, exactly in time.

lines.zh: 我们脚下的土被根须织成一张网。
lines.en: The soil beneath us is woven into a net of roots.

lines.zh: 等春天，新苗会在我们之间冒头。
lines.en: By spring, new shoots will rise between us.

lines.zh: 我弯腰拾起一枚落地的松果。
lines.en: I bend and pick up a pinecone from the ground.

lines.zh: 掉下的枝我捡起来，插回土里。
lines.en: Fallen branches I gather and plant back in the soil.

lines.zh: 我把滚远的松果收进树洞。
lines.en: I tuck the rolled-away pinecones into a tree hollow.

lines.zh: 有块石头压住幼树，我搬开了。
lines.en: A stone pins a young tree, so I move it aside.

lines.zh: 我拾起自己的断枝，慢慢接上。
lines.en: I pick up my own broken branch and slowly join it back.

lines.zh: 地上的松针我拢成一堆。
lines.en: I gather the pine needles on the ground into a heap.

lines.zh: 那枚远古松果，我含在树皮缝里。
lines.en: That ancient pinecone, I keep in a crack of my bark.

lines.zh: 我捡起被风刮落的鸟巢，放回枝上。
lines.en: I pick up a wind-torn nest and set it back on a branch.

lines.zh: 我把散落的种子埋进湿土。
lines.en: I bury the scattered seeds in the damp earth.

lines.zh: 拾来的东西我都归到根下。
lines.en: Everything I pick up ends up beneath my roots.

lines.zh: 有东西在砍我的根，我低头找。
lines.en: Something is chopping my root; I lower my head to find it.

lines.zh: 火光在林子边亮起，我转过去。
lines.en: A fire lights at the forest edge, and I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 谁在拖我的枝？我看见了。
lines.en: Who is dragging my branch? I see them.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把头转向那阵脚步声。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly toward those footsteps.

lines.zh: 一只小兽啃我的树皮，我盯住它。
lines.en: A small beast gnaws my bark, and I fix my gaze on it.

lines.zh: 雷声滚过来，我抬起了根。
lines.en: Thunder rolls in, and I lift a root.

lines.zh: 我在雾里认出那团移动的影子。
lines.en: In the mist I make out that moving shape.

lines.zh: 它拿走我的松果，我记住了。
lines.en: It took my pinecone; I have not forgotten.

lines.zh: 我的枝条绷直，指向那个方向。
lines.en: My branches pull straight, pointing that way.

lines.zh: 很近，但我要走很久才到。
lines.en: It is close, yet it will take me long to arrive.

lines.zh: 我把根须铺开，慢慢围过去。
lines.en: I spread my roots and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 它跑得快，我只好守住这片林。
lines.en: It runs fast, so I simply hold this patch of forest.

lines.zh: 我的树冠压低，遮住它的路。
lines.en: I lower my crown to cover its path.

lines.zh: 每走一步，我都停顿很久。
lines.en: With every step I take, I pause for a long time.

lines.zh: 它躲在树后，我不急着找。
lines.en: It hides behind a tree, and I do not hurry to find it.

lines.zh: 我把枝伸到它头顶，停住。
lines.en: I extend a branch above its head and stop.

lines.zh: 林子里都是我的根，它逃不远。
lines.en: My roots fill this wood; it cannot get far.

lines.zh: 我听着它的呼吸，判断距离。
lines.en: I listen to its breathing to judge the distance.

lines.zh: 它举起火把，我退了半步又站稳。
lines.en: It raises a torch; I give half a step and hold.

lines.zh: 我在等它先犯错。
lines.en: I am waiting for it to make the first mistake.

lines.zh: 一根粗枝砸下去，地面震了震。
lines.en: A thick branch comes down and the ground shudders.

lines.zh: 我把根须甩过去，缠住它的腿。
lines.en: I whip my roots across and coil them around its legs.

lines.zh: 树冠猛地一摆，把它扫进灌木。
lines.en: My crown swings hard and sweeps it into the bushes.

lines.zh: 我抬脚踩下，它从缝里滚开。
lines.en: I raise a foot and stamp; it rolls out from under.

lines.zh: 我俯身压过去，影子先罩住它。
lines.en: I lean down over it, and my shadow arrives first.

lines.zh: 枝干横扫，松针落了一地。
lines.en: My limb sweeps across and pine needles rain down.

lines.zh: 这一下我用了几十年的力气。
lines.en: I put decades of strength into that blow.

lines.zh: 它撞上我的树皮，弹了回去。
lines.en: It hits my bark and bounces back.

lines.zh: 我把根从土里抽出，抽在它背上。
lines.en: I pull a root from the soil and lash its back.

lines.zh: 我慢慢举起枝，又慢慢落下。
lines.en: I raise my branch slowly, then bring it down slowly.

lines.zh: 我在老云杉之间醒来，根先动了。
lines.en: I wake among old spruces, and my roots move first.

lines.zh: 土翻开，我从树桩里长出身子。
lines.en: The soil parts, and I grow a body out of a stump.

lines.zh: 这片林子比我年轻，我记得更老的。
lines.en: This wood is younger than I am; I remember older ones.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，是松脂的味道。
lines.en: The first breath I take tastes of pine resin.

lines.zh: 雾还没散，我站在原地看。
lines.en: The mist has not lifted, so I stand and watch.

lines.zh: 根须自己找到了水，我不用教。
lines.en: My roots find water by themselves; no one teaches them.

lines.zh: 我抬头，天被树冠切成碎片。
lines.en: I look up and the sky is cut into pieces by branches.

lines.zh: 身边没有同类，只有风。
lines.en: There are no kin beside me, only the wind.

lines.zh: 我从土里拔起身子，抖落松针。
lines.en: I rise out of the earth and shake off the pine needles.

lines.zh: 一枚旧松果滚到我脚边。
lines.en: An old pinecone rolls to my feet.

lines.zh: 林子的深处有雷声，我记住了。
lines.en: Thunder sounds deep in the forest, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 我站稳之后，才想起要走路。
lines.en: Only after I stand firm do I remember I can walk.

lines.zh: 火舌舔上树皮，我的根立刻往土里钻。
lines.en: Flames lick my bark and my roots dive for the soil.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下去，断了好几根枝。
lines.en: I slide down the slope and snap several branches.

lines.zh: 水漫过根须，我的呼吸变得又慢又沉。
lines.en: Water rises over my roots and my breathing turns slow and heavy.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀掉我半边树冠，我晃了很久。
lines.en: An explosion tears away half my crown, and I sway for ages.

lines.zh: 箭钉进树皮，像一根刺扎在年轮里。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my bark like a thorn in a ring.

lines.zh: 药水浸进根里，我的叶子一片片卷起。
lines.en: Potion soaks into my roots and my leaves curl one by one.

lines.zh: 土里没有水，我的枝软得抬不起来。
lines.en: There is no water in the soil, and my branches droop.

lines.zh: 雷劈中树冠，我整棵亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my crown and all of me lights up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，我的根无处可扎。
lines.en: There is no soil in the void, and my roots find nothing.
